answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 31711 Country: India Title: Can we take karaz from friend who has haram maal. Question: Can we take karaz from friend who has haram maal. Answer ID: 31711 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 994/550/D=1432) It is not lawful to take the exact haram money as debt. If the income is mixed or he gives the debt from halal money, (though his other earnings are haram) then it is allowable to take the debt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
